name: Nazrul geeti (Nazrul songs, Bengali)
lineage: Nazrul geeti Bengali art-song repertoire composed by Kazi Nazrul Islam (1899-1976, Bidrohi Kobi "Rebel Poet" and national poet of Bangladesh), comprising approximately three thousand documented songs: Islamic-devotional (Hamd-and-Naat in Bengali), Hindu-devotional Shyamasangeet (Bengali Kali songs), love and longing, revolutionary-political (anti-British-colonial Karar Oi Louho Kapat), and ghazal. Compositional language draws on Hindustani-classical raga vocabulary with strong influences from Persian-Urdu ghazal melodic-line aesthetic and Bengali folk-kirtan rhythmic conventions. The post-1976 Bangladeshi Nazrul Institute consolidated canonical standards.
